sliders.label: Risk tolerance
sliders.statement: Higher risk tolerance weights threat up and success odds down: as it rises, an option with more danger gain and no better odds never drops below one with less.

sliders.label: Verticality
sliders.statement: Higher verticality weights ground gained up and switches of play down: as it rises, an option that gains more ground and switches play no more never drops below one that gains less.

sliders.label: Press trigger
sliders.statement: A higher press trigger weights counter-press cover up: as it rises, an option with more teammates near where the ball could be lost never drops below one with fewer, all else equal.

sliders.label: Defensive line height
sliders.statement: A higher line weights rest defence up: as it rises, an option that leaves more of the space behind it covered never drops below one that leaves less, all else equal.
